title: Adobe for Startups launched with 12 months of free access to Firefly Pro Plus, Acrobat Studio and Semrush
summary: Adobe launches Adobe for Startups offering free access to Firefly Pro Plus and Acrobat
detailed: Adobe launched the 'Adobe for Startups' program to provide early-stage companies with free access to creative, document productivity, and marketing tools.
Eligible startups receive 12 months of free access to Adobe Firefly Pro Plus, Acrobat Studio (including Adobe Express Premium), and Semrush.
Companies founded within the last five years and with under USD 15 million in funding are eligible to apply.
The program matters because it lowers the barrier to entry for startups like DataCurve, Gondola, and Oruk to build brands and integrate AI tools into their workflows.
sentences: Adobe has launched Adobe for Startups, a program that provides early-stage companies with free access to its creative, document productivity and marketing tools to help them build their brands, create content and reach customers.
Eligible startups will receive 12 months of free access to Adobe Firefly Pro Plus, Acrobat Studio (including Adobe Express Premium) and Semrush.
The program also includes workshops, events and opportunities to learn from Adobe experts and connect with other founders.
The program brings together tools for content creation, document productivity and marketing.
Adobe will also offer workshops and events as part of the program.
On December 3, it will host a hands-on Brand on Demand workshop with Artist and the Machine, where participants can create a week’s worth of on-brand marketing content using Adobe’s AI tools.
Adobe highlighted three startups and how they use or plan to use its tools.

DataCurve is a fan identity and intelligence platform for sports, media and entertainment organizations that helps turn fragmented audience data into lasting fan relationships and measurable revenue growth.

Co-founder and CEO Aman Johar said the company already uses Adobe Firefly for creative assets and plans to explore integrating its fan intelligence into the creative process to create content based on individual fan interests.
Gondola is building a digital credit and portfolio system for the social media and digital content industry.
Founder and CEO Jared Kleinstein said the company has used Adobe’s tools since its early days to build its brand, create content and establish its presence in the market.
Oruk is a speech AI research lab developing foundation models that understand what people say and how they say it, including tone, emotion and delivery.
These models provide developers with context to build more responsive voice products.
Data Specialist Anastasia Zaporozhtseva said the company plans to use Adobe Express to turn its speech AI research into short visual demonstrations, grow its brand and reach more developers.
Startups founded within the last five years and with less than USD 15 million in funding can apply for Adobe for Startups.
Adobe will verify eligibility as part of the application process.
Note: Program terms, eligibility criteria and country availability apply.
